patch_description: Introduce per-upload deltas for the RY layer by replacing ry_corner/ry_edge/ry_center parameters with a shared base plus per-upload deltas. This preserves circuit structure while adding a richer parameterization without a huge depth increase. Deltas are hosted as additional param keys using dummy gates that are ignored during execution, enabling per-upload expressivity and potential performance gains.
